summary: HCA Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $6.5B seven-tranche senior notes offering, fully guaranteed by parent HCA Healthcare. Terms: $500M 5.200% 2028s, $300M SOFR+0.750% floating 2028s, $1.0B 5.350% 2029s, $1.25B 5.500% 2031s, $1.2B 5.750% 2033s, $1.5B 6.000% 2036s and $750M 6.500% 2056s, with change-of-control repurchase rights and fixed-rate call features. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; proceeds are presumed for general corporate purposes. Watch leverage and refinancing cadence rather than deal arbitrage.
